mentions.name: docx-editor.dev
mentions.description: An open-source, MIT-licensed word editor library for working with .docx documents. It is built to serve the maintainers' core business and other engineers who need such a library, and it has active contributors submitting bug reports and fixes from people building apps around .docx docs. It is developed heavily with AI under community feedback and oversight.
mentions.problem: An open-source word editor library for .docx documents was needed in the authors' core business, and many other engineers seemed to need one too.
mentions.audience: Engineers and developers building apps around .docx documents, including the maintainers' own core business.
